text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests; to begin our assessment, have you noticed any changes in your stool color or urine darkening?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) is less likely given the male sex and ulcerative colitis history; the combination of fatigue, pruritus, abnormal LFTs, and high-risk sexual behavior strongly suggests Hepatitis B or C infection. I will now order specific viral serologies and autoantibody testing to confirm the etiology.

REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_Surface_Antigen, Hepatitis_C_Antibody, Anti-mitochondrial_Antibody
